correctness.rationale: For the explicit full-branch cusp family, inverse equations uniquely define preimages and yield exact weights. Weighted BV jump variation contracts uniformly, so stationary BV densities are interior continuous; dense inverse orbits force positivity. Direct transfer asymptotic gives a nonzero z^gamma coefficient; 1D Sobolev trace inequalities rigorously exclude every p>=alpha/(2alpha-1). Limitation: stationary BV existence for arbitrary mixture is assumed, not asserted.

value.rationale: The opposite-side transition beyond the critical square-root cusp is a motivated regularity barrier for stationary densities of expanding systems. The exact exponent and positive coefficient, persistent under nontrivial finite randomization, show why W2,1-based response methods cannot be extended naively to beta>-1/2. This is a structural obstruction, not a restatement of a spectral bound; no lower-p membership is claimed.
